objective: Assemble one exact complete L000 draft lesson contract from accepted upstream artifacts without changing their decisions.
learner_baseline: Assume random 1.2B parameters: zero bankable semantics, grammar, discourse, world knowledge, or identity grounding. Encoder exposure is an untrusted bonus.
binding_precedence: Accepted phased artifacts override obsolete source flags such as picture_book=no in the pre-spec selection packet.
The accepted visual plan medium-003 supersedes medium-002 and contains zero active crops.
Full relational scenes must remain full; portraits are the only isolated identity controls.
The language progression fixes exact presentation, controlled, mixed, reserve, budget, and gate behavior.
assembly_rules: Use schema ninereeds_lesson_contract_v3 and status draft.
Every presentation exercise is model_only with speaker_identity null, evidence_use presentation_only, target_language_required false, and expected_answers [].
All scored spoken L000 responses are learner_self, speaker_identity Ninereeds, and evidence_use learner_identity_and_language.
Story speaker-attribution checks are nonverbal_selection with concept_only_nonverbal evidence and use accepted portraits as choice assets.
Use the exact accepted mixed order and only pre-authored reserves/frozen IDs for interventions.
Declare exactly the 13 accepted master assets; declare no crop assets or crop operations.
Keep independent review pending and rehearsal required_pending; this is the pre-gate draft.
Bind every source, prompt, receipt, image, and policy by repository-relative path and current lowercase SHA-256.
Do not dispatch training, invent language, add a vocabulary set, change story pages, or silently repair an upstream mismatch.
verification: Run compile_lesson.py validate --stage draft. If validation fails, preserve the draft and report exact errors; do not weaken contracts to force a pass.
